serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
At first I thought it was coming from my door, because it was so loud, but it’s not. What’s going on?
Is it coming from another apartment? Probably. There’s no other explanation. God damn that was loud for something coming through a wall. 
Even this trash music wasn’t enough to cover this hammering. 
I wonder what’s going on. I’m gonna try to listen to it.
???: TURN IT OFF FUCKER!
